A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual only known as "'''Twilight'''" lived around [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]]. She was rumored to have once been a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who had left that organization in search of a new beginning.<ref name="LECG" />

Shortly after the<ref name="LECG" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dyspeth system/Legends|Dyspeth system]]</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dyspeth]] was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Twilight attempted to use her [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] in order to unite other [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive individuals among the colonists. In doing so, Twilight's goal was for them to adapt to the darkness of the perpetually shadowed moon. Twilight eventually founded the Force-user group known as the [[Disciples of Twilight]], members of which predominantly used the Force to manipulate light and, during the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] following the group's establishment, became the protectors of Dyspeth's inhabitants.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Twilight was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
